description: This file defines a utility class 'GLToolbox' with static methods for loading shaders, creating shader programs, error checking, and initializing OpenGL texture parameters, used within an Android media effects application.

classes.name: GLToolbox
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for handling common OpenGL ES 2.0 tasks such as shader compilation, program linking, error checking, and texture parameter initialization.

methods.name: loadShader
methods.description: Compiles a shader of specified type with given source code, throws RuntimeException if compilation fails.

methods.name: createProgram
methods.description: Creates and links an OpenGL program from vertex and fragment shader source codes, throws RuntimeException if linking fails.

methods.name: checkGlError
methods.description: Checks for OpenGL errors and throws RuntimeException if any error is found.

methods.name: initTexParams
methods.description: Initializes texture parameters to linear filtering and clamp-to-edge wrapping.
